# A segment: '= <label> <knock knocks expected> <single knocks expected, - for any>', then
# '<ms> <ax> <ay> <az>' per 50 Hz sample, raw IMU frame, milli-g. USB-C up is home (rotation 2).
# Recorded before imu_qmi8658.h negated z: here az is +1 g face DOWN (z into the screen).
# KnockSense and the shake read magnitudes and differences, so the sign does not matter to them.
# 1_home: picked up from a desk and held, with some wiggling (a single knock from the wiggle is fine). 2b: five knock knocks held still
# (and a triple knock just after a grip shift, which does not count). 3: five single knocks.
# 4/5: four quarter turns each way, held 3 s. 6: four short turns. 7: two hangs.
# 8: picked up, carried, set down hard, pocketed, held upside down: everyday handling.
# 9: a shake, then picked up, handled and left leaning on its edge.
# L1 (later, the KnockSense build): lying face down 140 s, then picked up, five knock knocks (two of them soft, one on
# the rim) and a triple knock: six knock knocks.
# L2: lying face down 80 s, then five knock knocks (one quick, 0.12 s apart; one soft; one
# on the rim) and a triple: six.
# From T1 on (the 250 Hz build, z negated: +1 g face up) a line has three more numbers, the
# 250 Hz peak. T1: face up on a table, about ten knock knocks, soft and hard (count not
# kept: at least five). T2: face up on the desk, untouched, while typing, cups set down,
# the desk bumped and leaned on: none. T3: face up on a table, eight knock knocks (often a
# soft first knock and a harder second) and a triple: nine.
